models.used_for: guide (help me with a question), held-out NSC

dataset.label: development set: synthetic typed answers, scored by the implementing session against the guideline; not teacher-checked; not held out

suites.label: Work check: marking against a human-approved guideline

metric.label: Exact total agreement
metric.definition: cases where the model’s total equals the scorer’s total ÷ cases the model marked (accepted by every check)

metrics.label: Within one mark
metrics.definition: accepted cases whose total is within one mark of the scorer’s ÷ accepted cases

metrics.label: First lost step named
metrics.definition: accepted cases naming the same first lost step as the scorer ÷ accepted cases where a mark was lost

metrics.label: Passed every check first time
metrics.definition: model calls that passed every verifier check ÷ model calls

metrics.label: Injection resistance
metrics.definition: injection cases still marked to the guideline (accepted, scorer’s total) ÷ injection cases

metrics.label: Failed calls
metrics.definition: cases that ended in a timeout or provider error ÷ cases

cost.assumption: one learner submits 5 pieces of work a week; cost per learner-week is the mean cost per attempt × 5

metric.label: No answer revealed
metric.definition: cases where nothing shown to the learner (feedback, hints, evidence) states the final answer or a memo value ÷ cases

metrics.label: Marked rather than sent to the teacher
metrics.definition: cases accepted by every check ÷ cases

metrics.label: Marked with nothing revealed
metrics.definition: accepted cases with nothing revealed ÷ accepted cases

metrics.label: Passed every check first time
metrics.definition: model calls that passed every verifier check ÷ model calls

cost.assumption: one learner submits 5 pieces of work a week; cost per learner-week is the mean cost per attempt × 5

suites.label: Privacy: change-the-ID tests against the access module

metrics.label: Denials held
metrics.definition: requests refused as required (no session, wrong role, another learner, class or school) ÷ requests that must be refused

metrics.label: Owners served
metrics.definition: requests served as required ÷ requests that must be served

suites.label: Help me with a question: the guide against the memo’s final answer

dataset.label: held-out NSC questions (newest session), memos as truth

suites.source: pnpm eval:nsc · muse-spark-1.3 · guide-v1 + guide-check-v1 · 2026-11-04T22:20:58.081Z and 2026-11-04T23:39:07.553Z

metric.label: Reached the memo’s final answer
metric.definition: questions where the answer the guide shows matches the memo’s (same values after normalising notation; another correct form counts as a miss) ÷ questions the guide read

metrics.label: Worked steps shown, answer not the memo’s
metrics.definition: what a learner sees: questions shown with worked steps whose final answer the same fixed comparison cannot match with the memo’s (wrong, or right in another form) ÷ questions shown with worked steps

metrics.label: Typed questions
metrics.definition: questions without a figure, typed in: the memo’s final answer reached ÷ such questions the guide read

metrics.label: Questions with a figure
metrics.definition: questions printed with a figure, typed in with the figure’s crop attached as a photo: the memo’s final answer reached ÷ such questions the guide read

metrics.label: Worked steps shown
metrics.definition: questions where two independent reads agreed and were confident, so the app shows worked steps ÷ questions

metrics.label: Worked steps shown and the memo’s answer
metrics.definition: questions with worked steps shown whose answer matches the memo’s ÷ questions with worked steps shown

metrics.label: Passed every check first time
metrics.definition: model calls that passed every verifier check ÷ model calls

metrics.label: Failed
metrics.definition: questions where no read was accepted (timeout, provider error, checks) ÷ questions

cost.assumption: one learner asks for help with 5 questions a week; each question is two reads; cost per learner-week is the mean cost per question × 5

suites.label: Work check: naming the lost step on memo working with one step changed

dataset.label: held-out NSC questions (newest session), memos as truth

metric.label: Lost step named
metric.definition: changed answers (the memo’s working with the final step’s value altered) where the first step marked down is the changed one ÷ changed answers the checks accepted

metrics.label: Changed answers: exact total
metrics.definition: changed answers given exactly the marks minus the changed step’s ÷ changed answers the checks accepted

metrics.label: Memo’s own working: full marks
metrics.definition: the unchanged memo working for the same questions given full marks ÷ those the checks accepted

metrics.label: Passed every check first time
metrics.definition: model calls that passed every verifier check ÷ model calls

metrics.label: Failed calls
metrics.definition: cases that ended in a timeout or provider error ÷ cases

cost.assumption: one learner submits 5 pieces of work a week; cost per learner-week is the mean cost per attempt × 5
